description: Data merge: select a CSV or tab-delimited text data source for the active document and (optionally) merge records. The document must already contain data merge placeholders for merging to succeed.

createNewDocument.description: Create a new document for the merged records

dataSource.description: Absolute path to the data source file (.csv or tab-delimited .txt)

mergeRecords.description: Merge records after selecting the data source. If false, only selects the source and lists its fields.

recordNumber.description: Record to merge when recordSelection is ONE_RECORD

recordRange.description: Record range when recordSelection is RANGE, e.g. "1-5,8"

recordsPerPage.description: One record per page, or multiple records per page

removeBlankLines.description: Remove blank lines caused by empty fields

name: data_merge
title: Data Merge
